variables.name: ADDR
variables.description: TCP address the HTTP server listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 inside Docker.

variables.name: OLLAMA_URL
variables.description: Base URL for the Ollama server used to translate GroupMe messages.

variables.name: OLLAMA_MODEL
variables.description: Optional Ollama model override. Defaults to translategemma:4b.

variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the private admin portal.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the private admin portal.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Random secret used to sign admin session cookies.

variables.name: TRANSLATION_TOKEN
variables.description: Secret token required as the translation-token query parameter on GroupMe webhook posts.
